An MCP server that transforms vague prompts into platform-optimized prompts for 58 AI platforms across 7 categories.

Send a raw prompt. Get back a version specifically optimized for Midjourney, DALL-E, Sora, Runway, ElevenLabs, Claude, ChatGPT, or any of the 58 supported platforms — with the right syntax, parameters, and structure each platform expects.

LLM_API_KEY.description: API key for the LLM provider. Required for cloud providers like OpenAI or Anthropic, but not needed for local Ollama.

LLM_API_URL.description: API endpoint URL (e.g., http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama, https://api.openai.com/v1 for OpenAI, or https://api.anthropic.com/v1 for Anthropic).

SEARCH_API_KEY.description: API key for the selected web search provider.

SEARCH_PROVIDER.description: Optional web search provider for context enrichment. Supported providers include: tavily, brave, serper, serpapi, exa, or searxng.

servers.name: Clarifyprompt-MCP

servers.description: Enables AI assistants to directly control Autodesk 3ds Max through natural language to create models, set materials, adjust lighting, and automate animations. It bridges the Model Context Protocol with 3ds Max via a TCP socket to execute Python and MAXScript commands.
servers.name: 3dsmax-mcp

servers.description: A Model Context Protocol server that facilitates seamless communication between ABAP systems and MCP clients for managing ABAP objects, transport requests, and code analysis. It acts as a wrapper for the ABAP ADT API to enhance the efficiency of ABAP development workflows.

SAP_URL.description: The URL of your SAP server, including port (e.g., https://your-sap-server.com:44300)

SAP_CLIENT.description: The SAP client ID (optional but recommended)

SAP_LANGUAGE.description: The SAP system language (optional but recommended)

NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED.description: Set to '0' to allow connections with self-signed certificates

servers.name: ABAP-ADT-API MCP-Server

servers.description: MCP server for managing affiliate and referral programs. Track referrals, manage affiliates, process conversions, and handle payouts through AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, and ChatGPT.

REFGROW_API_URL.description: Base URL of your Refgrow instance

servers.name: Refgrow MCP Server

servers.description: Provides real-time Indian stock market analysis, including live price tracking, technical indicators, and options Greeks calculations for NSE/BSE securities. It also enables news-based sentiment analysis, market scanning for NIFTY 50 stocks, and virtual portfolio management.

NEWS_API_KEY.description: Your API key for NewsAPI (available at https://newsapi.org/), used for news-based sentiment analysis tools.

servers.name: IndiaQuant MCP Server

servers.description: Integrates the OpenViking context database with Cloudwise SA Workflow Skills to enable semantic search and access to product catalogs or solution templates. It supports hierarchical context loading for optimized token usage and includes a mock mode for testing without a live backend.
servers.name: OpenViking MCP Server

servers.description: Enables AI assistants to interact with the TgeBrowser Local API to create, manage, and automate isolated browser environments. It supports comprehensive browser automation tasks including navigation, element interaction, and fingerprint configuration through natural language.

PORT.description: Port of the TgeBrowser Local API. Default is 50326. Can also be set via the --port argument.

API_KEY.description: API Key for TgeBrowser, sent as an Authorization: Bearer header. Can also be set via the --api-key argument.

servers.name: TgeBrowser MCP Server

servers.description: A Model Context Protocol server for the resQ emergency response system that integrates with digital twin simulations and coordination engines. It allows users to trigger simulations, generate deployment strategies, and monitor real-time drone status for incident response analysis.
servers.name: resQ MCP Server

servers.description: Provides current weather conditions, seven-day forecasts, and US weather alerts using Open-Meteo and National Weather Service APIs. It enables users to retrieve global weather data and regional alerts without requiring any API keys.
servers.name: Weather MCP

servers.description:
JSON-driven E2E test runner for AI agents. Define browser tests as JSON action arrays and run them in parallel
against a Chrome pool (browserless/chrome) with 28+ built-in actions, visual verification, network debugging, and
flaky test detection.

RETRIES.description: Number of times to retry failed tests

AUTH_TOKEN.description: JWT or session token injected into browser storage for authenticated pages

ACTION_RETRIES.description: Number of times to retry failed individual actions

AUTH_STORAGE_KEY.description: The key name used to store the AUTH_TOKEN in localStorage/sessionStorage (defaults to accessToken)

FAIL_ON_NETWORK_ERROR.description: Whether to fail tests when network errors are detected

servers.name: mtw-e2e-runner

servers.description: Enables programmatic control of Android devices via ADB, supporting UI automation, app management, screen capture with OCR, and file transfers through the Model Context Protocol. It allows MCP-compatible clients like Claude Desktop and Cursor to interact directly with physical or emulated Android devices.
servers.name: Android ADB MCP Server

servers.description: A comprehensive framework for building and deploying commercial MCP servers with integrated billing, usage metering, and Stripe payment processing. It enables developers to monetize AI tools through a complete ecosystem including API key management, affiliate tracking, and automated deployment scripts.
servers.name: Prepcast MCP

servers.description: Converts web pages and HTML strings into clean, LLM-optimized Markdown with metadata extraction and token estimation. It uses a lightweight, browserless approach to provide token-efficient output for more effective LLM processing.
servers.name: readdown-mcp

servers.description: PT-Edge gives AI assistants live intelligence on the AI ecosystem — 47 tools to search 11K+ GitHub repos, 18K+ HuggingFace models, 42K+ datasets, and 2,500+ public APIs, plus trend analysis, project comparison, and community discourse tracking across Hacker News and V2EX.

PT_EDGE_TOKEN.description: The authentication token required to connect to the PT-Edge MCP server (found in the connection URL: https://mcp.phasetransitions.ai/mcp?token=YOUR_TOKEN)

servers.name: PT-Edge
